$msgId..validate: newData.hasChildren(['from', 'text', 'at']) && newData.child('from').isString() && (newData.child('from').val() == 'customer' || newData.child('from').val() == 'courier') && newData.child('text').isString() && newData.child('text').val().length > 0 && newData.child('text').val().length <= 500

$orderId..validate: newData.hasChildren(['code', 'service', 'status', 'createdAt']) && newData.child('status').isString() && (newData.child('status').val() == 'menunggu' || newData.child('status').val() == 'diterima' || newData.child('status').val() == 'dijemput' || newData.child('status').val() == 'diantar' || newData.child('status').val() == 'selesai' || newData.child('status').val() == 'dibatalkan')
